newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada appoints regional representatives.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada appoints regional representatives.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Wednesday announced the appointment of senior representatives to staff its five regional offices across Canada.

The appointments follow the bank's decision to boost its regional presence through increased economic monitoring of the areas. The regional offices will also oversee and monitor ongoing responsibilities for delivering bank note, bond and banking services.

The newly appointed senior economics representatives for the regional offices are Paul Fenton (Atlantic provinces), Louis-Robert Lafleur (Quebec), Brigid Brady (Ontario), Hung-Hay Lau (Prairies and Northwest Territories) and Mike Stockfish (British Columbia and Yukon Territories).

The senior operations representatives are Bob Dolomont (Atlantic provinces), Lorraine Laviolette (Quebec), Harry Hooper (Prairies and Northwest Territories) and Bill Watson (British Columbia and Yukon Territories).
